verdict.rationale: Fathom's plans list "AI generated action items" [fathom-docs-28], and its webhooks can deliver action items to an endpoint you choose [fathom-docs-22, fathom-docs-45], so automatic extraction is evidenced. However, nothing shows action items being assigned to owners, and collecting them for tracking appears to require building your own webhook integration. Missing for 10: evidence that action items carry owner/assignee attribution, a native place to track action items (or an out-of-box task-tool sync), and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
